problems.title: UnsupportedClassVersionError: class file version 65.0, runtime only recognizes up to 61.0
problems.body:
Running the jar fails:
Exception in thread "main" java.lang.UnsupportedClassVersionError: com/example/App has been compiled by a more recent version of the Java Runtime (class file version 65.0), this version of the Java Runtime only recognizes class file versions up to 61.0

solutions.body: Class file 65 is Java 21; your runtime is Java 17. Run with JDK 21 (set JAVA_HOME) or compile with --release 17.
solutions.code:
java -version
# either point JAVA_HOME at JDK 21, or in pom.xml:
<maven.compiler.release>17</maven.compiler.release>

problems.title: Spring Boot: Web server failed to start. Port 8080 was already in use.
problems.body:
***************************
APPLICATION FAILED TO START
***************************
Description:
Web server failed to start. Port 8080 was already in use.

solutions.body: Run on another port, or stop the process holding 8080.

problems.title: Maven: PKIX path building failed: unable to find valid certification path
problems.body:
Behind the corporate proxy, mvn install fails:
sun.security.validator.ValidatorException: PKIX path building failed: sun.security.provider.certpath.SunCertPathBuilderException: unable to find valid certification path to requested target

solutions.body: Import the corporate root CA into the JDK truststore used by Maven.

problems.title: Lombok on JDK 21: NoSuchFieldError JCTree$JCImport qualid
problems.body:
Compilation fails after upgrading to JDK 21:
java.lang.NoSuchFieldError: Class com.sun.tools.javac.tree.JCTree$JCImport does not have member field 'com.sun.tools.javac.tree.JCTree qualid'

solutions.body: Lombok before 1.18.30 does not support JDK 21. Upgrade Lombok.

problems.title: permission denied while trying to connect to the Docker daemon socket
problems.body:
docker ps fails:
Got permission denied while trying to connect to the Docker daemon socket at unix:///var/run/docker.sock: Get "http://%2Fvar%2Frun%2Fdocker.sock/v1.24/containers/json": dial unix /var/run/docker.sock: connect: permission denied

solutions.body: Add your user to the docker group and start a new login session.
solutions.code:
sudo usermod -aG docker $USER
newgrp docker
docker ps

problems.title: Docker Desktop: WSL 2 installation is incomplete / WSL update failed
problems.body: Docker Desktop on Windows won't start: 'WSL 2 installation is incomplete' and later 'Docker Desktop - WSL update failed'.

solutions.body: Update WSL and ensure the Virtual Machine Platform feature is enabled, then reboot.

problems.title: exec /usr/local/bin/docker-entrypoint.sh: exec format error
problems.body:
Image built on my M2 MacBook fails on the Linux server with:
exec /usr/local/bin/docker-entrypoint.sh: exec format error

solutions.body: The image was built for arm64 but the server is amd64. Build for the target platform with buildx.

problems.title: Bind for 0.0.0.0:5432 failed: port is already allocated
problems.body:
docker compose up fails:
Error response from daemon: driver failed programming external connectivity on endpoint db: Bind for 0.0.0.0:5432 failed: port is already allocated

solutions.body: A local Postgres (or another container) already uses 5432. Map a different host port in docker-compose.yml.

problems.title: Container cannot reach a service on the host via localhost
problems.body:
My app inside a container calls http://localhost:8000 (a service running on the host) and gets:
Error: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:8000

solutions.body: Inside a container localhost is the container itself. Use host.docker.internal to reach the host.
On Linux host.docker.internal is not defined by default; map it to the host gateway explicitly.

problems.title: fatal: refusing to merge unrelated histories
problems.body:
I created a repo on GitHub with a README, then tried to pull into my local project:
fatal: refusing to merge unrelated histories

solutions.body: Allow merging the two independent histories once.

problems.title: remote: Support for password authentication was removed
problems.body:
git push asks for my GitHub password and then fails:
remote: Support for password authentication was removed on August 13, 2021.
fatal: Authentication failed for 'https://github.com/me/repo.git/'

solutions.body: Authenticate with a credential helper via the GitHub CLI (or use a personal access token / SSH).
solutions.code:
gh auth login
gh auth setup-git
git push

problems.title: Updates were rejected because the tip of your current branch is behind
problems.body:
git push fails:
! [rejected]        main -> main (non-fast-forward)
error: failed to push some refs to 'github.com:me/repo.git'
hint: Updates were rejected because the tip of your current branch is behind its remote counterpart.

solutions.body: Integrate the remote commits first, then push.
solutions.code:
git pull --rebase origin main
git push

solutions.body: Force push to overwrite the remote. Discards other people's commits; only safe on a branch nobody else uses.

problems.title: /bin/sh^M: bad interpreter after cloning on Windows
problems.body:
A shell script checked out on Windows fails in the Linux container:
/bin/sh^M: bad interpreter: No such file or directory
Git also warned: in the working copy of 'entrypoint.sh', LF will be replaced by CRLF

solutions.body: Force LF endings for shell scripts with .gitattributes and renormalize the working tree.
solutions.code:
echo "*.sh text eol=lf" >> .gitattributes
git add --renormalize .
git commit -m "Normalize line endings"

problems.title: git@github.com: Permission denied (publickey)
problems.body:
git clone over SSH fails:
git@github.com: Permission denied (publickey).
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.

solutions.body: Create an SSH key, load it into the agent, add the public key to GitHub, and test the connection.
solutions.code:
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "you@example.com"
ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
# add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub at GitHub > Settings > SSH and GPG keys
ssh -T git@github.com

problems.title: pnpm.ps1 cannot be loaded because running scripts is disabled on this system
problems.body:
In PowerShell:
pnpm : File C:\Users\me\AppData\Roaming\npm\pnpm.ps1 cannot be loaded because running scripts is disabled on this system. For more information, see about_Execution_Policies.

solutions.body: Allow locally installed scripts for your user only.
